reviews.comment: I was introduced to Craig and Stephan by my Sales Manager, who had used Sun Logic for several installations for our customers. Stephan and his Team kept me up to date at all times. I was never left wondering where we were on the project. I could not be happier with the result, neat installation and working better than expected. If you are going to make this investment, I highly recommend Sun Logic to get you the best equipment, professionally installed. My system comprises a Deye 8kva Inverter, 9kva Battery, and 12 Solar Panels.
